index.title: ColdHello - Make the first move without saying a word
index.description: ColdHello helps shy people make the first move with a private, pressure-free prompt. No accounts, no tracking, and your contacts stay on your phone.
index.ogDescription: Make the first move without saying a word.
index.heroEyebrow: ColdHello / The next moment is yours
index.heroDetail: Hand over your phone. They see one clear, neutral question and choose privately. No pickup line. No public pressure.
index.microProofRest: No account. No tracking. Contacts stay on your device.
index.heroProductAria: Preview of the private question shown in ColdHello
index.problemHeadline: The hardest part is often the first five seconds.
index.problemBody: You noticed someone. You want to say hello. Then your mind goes blank and the moment passes.
index.problemNoteLead: ColdHello does not promise a yes.
index.problemNoteRest: It simply gives you a respectful way to ask and gives them a clear way to answer.
index.flowIntro: No script to memorize. The app guides the moment, then gets out of the way.

steps.title: Spot the moment
steps.body: Choose someone you would genuinely like to meet.

steps.title: Hand over your phone
steps.body: They see a neutral question, never the app name or your private dashboard.

steps.title: They decide privately
steps.body: They can say yes, decline, or leave. Their answer stays between you.

steps.title: Check later
steps.body: If they choose yes, their name and number are saved locally in the app.

index.privacyHeadline: A clear choice for them. Private data for you.
index.privacyBody: The stranger-facing screen stays neutral. A decline closes the interaction gracefully and never reveals your private home screen.

index.faqHeadline: Before you hand over your phone.

faqs.q: Will they see the app name?
faqs.a: No. The stranger-facing flow shows only a neutral question and response choices. Your dashboard and app branding stay hidden.

faqs.q: What happens if they say no?
faqs.a: They see a calm acknowledgement and the flow ends. Going back cannot expose your private home screen.
Only on your device. ColdHello does not run servers that receive your contacts, preferences, or approach history.

faqs.q: When does a free approach count?
faqs.a: It counts when you tap START, whether the other person accepts or declines. You can start up to 10 free approaches per installation, or save up to 5 contacts, whichever happens first.
Official download buttons appear here when each store listing is live.

support.title: Support - ColdHello
support.description: Get answers about ColdHello, free approaches, subscriptions, privacy, saved contacts, and purchase restoration.
support.heading: Support
support.intro: Clear answers about using ColdHello, keeping your data private, and managing Pro.

items.a: Choose who you would like to meet, start the approach, and hand them your phone. They see a neutral question and can answer privately. If they say yes, they enter their own name and number.

items.q: Does the person see the app name?
items.a: No. The stranger-facing screen never displays ColdHello branding, your dashboard, or your settings. It shows only the neutral interaction.
The app shows a calm acknowledgement and ends the stranger-facing flow. Back navigation does not reveal your private home screen.
Names and numbers are stored only on your device. ColdHello does not operate servers that receive your contacts, preferences, or approach history.
Yes. Uninstalling permanently removes ColdHello's local data. Save any important numbers to your phone's regular contacts first.
No. ColdHello does not use advertising, third-party analytics, or behavioral tracking. Subscription processing is handled separately by Apple or Google using RevenueCat.

items.q: How does the free tier work?
items.a: You can start up to 10 free approaches per installation, or save up to 5 contacts, whichever happens first. An approach counts when you tap START, whether the answer is yes or no. After that, Pro unlocks unlimited approaches.
The exact monthly and annual price, currency, taxes, and availability are shown by the App Store or Google Play before purchase and may vary by region.
Open Settings in the app and choose Restore purchases. Make sure the device uses the same Apple ID or Google account that made the purchase.
Manage or cancel your subscription from your Apple ID or Google Play account settings. Payments and cancellations are not handled directly inside ColdHello.
